text.en: Shoppers visiting the Fishamble Street store consistently praise staff members Jordan and James for their welcoming approach and deep expertise. Reviewers highlight that the team takes ample time to answer questions and explain terrarium requirements thoroughly for newcomers.

title.en: Specialised vivarium shop in Temple Bar

text.en: Customers appreciate the unique retail environment located in central Dublin, describing the shop as clean, tidy, and well organised. Visitors note that the shelves offer a comprehensive assortment of terrarium heating bulbs, live feeder insects, and specialized habitats.

title.en: Helpful advice with occasional dispatch delays

text.en: Most patrons report clear advice and attentive communication when purchasing supplies in person or ordering live food. However, feedback includes a rare complaint regarding an extended delivery delay and unanswered order status calls, though in-store service is widely commended.

q.en: Where is the shop located in Dublin?

a.en: The shop is located at 27 Fishamble Street in the Temple Bar area of Dublin 8.

q.en: Does the shop stock live feeder insects?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently purchase live worms, crickets, and feeder food with fast delivery options available.

q.en: Can staff assist beginners with reptile setups?

a.en: Yes, reviewers emphasize that the team takes ample time to explain heating, habitats, and feeding requirements to first-time owners.

q.en: Does the shop provide exotic pet boarding?

a.en: Yes, the shop offers boarding services for reptiles and exotics while owners are away.
